blockers.description: Task 3 of plan 01-04 is a blocking checkpoint:human-verify task requiring a real Apollo Master API key and sending domain. Streamlit does not execute app.py until a live browser WebSocket session connects, so curl-based checks cannot verify the rendered page, DB auto-create, or error banner — only static/AST checks were possible.
blockers.workaround: User adds real credentials to .streamlit/secrets.toml locally, then either (a) Claude uses browser automation (claude-in-chrome) to verify visually and reports back, or (b) user runs `streamlit run app.py` themselves and reports back with "approved" or a description of what's wrong.
